<!-- Design System -->
<!DOCTYPE html><html class="light" lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
<title>BabyGrow - Onboarding</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@500;700;800&amp;family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@100..900&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<script id="tailwind-config">
      tailwind.config = {
        darkMode: "class",
        theme: {
          extend: {
            "colors": {
                    "primary": "#b60059",
                    "on-tertiary-container": "#f7fff0",
                    "outline": "#906e76",
                    "on-tertiary-fixed": "#002203",
                    "surface-container-high": "#e8e8e8",
                    "on-primary-container": "#fffbff",
                    "surface-container-highest": "#e2e2e2",
                    "secondary-fixed": "#e2e2e2",
                    "tertiary-fixed": "#7ffd7c",
                    "surface-dim": "#dadada",
                    "inverse-on-surface": "#f0f1f1",
                    "primary-fixed-dim": "#ffb1c4",
                    "inverse-surface": "#2f3131",
                    "on-surface": "#1a1c1c",
                    "surface-variant": "#e2e2e2",
                    "background": "#f9f9f9",
                    "secondary-container": "#e2e2e2",
                    "on-tertiary-fixed-variant": "#00530f",
                    "on-secondary-fixed-variant": "#474747",
                    "inverse-primary": "#ffb1c4",
                    "secondary-fixed-dim": "#c6c6c6",
                    "on-error-container": "#93000a",
                    "surface": "#f9f9f9",
                    "surface-container-low": "#f3f3f4",
                    "outline-variant": "#e5bcc5",
                    "on-error": "#ffffff",
                    "primary-fixed": "#ffd9e1",
                    "on-primary-fixed-variant": "#8f0044",
                    "surface-container-lowest": "#ffffff",
                    "tertiary": "#006b17",
                    "on-primary-fixed": "#3f001a",
                    "surface-bright": "#f9f9f9",
                    "on-surface-variant": "#5c3f46",
                    "on-secondary": "#ffffff",
                    "primary-container": "#e30071",
                    "on-secondary-container": "#646464",
                    "error-container": "#ffdad6",
                    "surface-tint": "#ba005b",
                    "tertiary-container": "#008820",
                    "error": "#ba1a1a",
                    "secondary": "#5e5e5e",
                    "on-tertiary": "#ffffff",
                    "on-secondary-fixed": "#1b1b1b",
                    "on-background": "#1a1c1c",
                    "surface-container": "#eeeeee",
                    "on-primary": "#ffffff",
                    "tertiary-fixed-dim": "#63e063"
            },
            "borderRadius": {
                    "DEFAULT": "0.25rem",
                    "lg": "0.5rem",
                    "xl": "0.75rem",
                    "full": "9999px"
            },
            "spacing": {
                    "section-margin": "40px",
                    "container-padding": "24px",
                    "stack-gap": "16px",
                    "element-gap": "12px"
            },
            "fontFamily": {
                    "label-caps": ["Plus Jakarta Sans"],
                    "button-text": ["Plus Jakarta Sans"],
                    "headline-lg-mobile": ["Plus Jakarta Sans"],
                    "body-md": ["Plus Jakarta Sans"],
                    "display-lg": ["Plus Jakarta Sans"],
                    "headline-lg": ["Plus Jakarta Sans"]
            },
            "fontSize": {
                    "label-caps": ["12px", {"lineHeight": "16px", "letterSpacing": "0.05em", "fontWeight": "700"}],
                    "button-text": ["16px", {"lineHeight": "20px", "fontWeight": "700"}],
                    "headline-lg-mobile": ["24px", {"lineHeight": "32px", "fontWeight": "700"}],
                    "body-md": ["16px", {"lineHeight": "24px", "fontWeight": "500"}],
                    "display-lg": ["40px", {"lineHeight": "48px", "letterSpacing": "-0.02em", "fontWeight": "800"}],
                    "headline-lg": ["28px", {"lineHeight": "36px", "letterSpacing": "-0.01em", "fontWeight": "700"}]
            }
          },
        },
      }
    </script>
<style>
      body {
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
      }
      .diffusion-shadow {
        box-shadow: 0px 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
      }
      .dark .diffusion-shadow {
        box-shadow: 0px 20px 40px rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.1);
      }
      .vibrant-pink-glow {
        box-shadow: 0px 10px 25px rgba(182, 0, 89, 0.3);
      }
      .glass-bg {
        backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      }
      .dark .glass-bg {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      }
    </style>
<style>
    body {
      min-height: max(884px, 100dvh);
    }
  </style>
  </head>
<body class="bg-background text-on-background font-body-md text-body-md min-h-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
<!-- Top AppBar (Identity Anchor) -->
<header class="w-full top-0 px-container-padding pt-8 flex justify-between items-center z-10">
<div class="font-display-lg text-display-lg text-primary tracking-tighter">BabyGrow</div>
<button class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary p-2 active:scale-95 transition-transform" data-icon="settings_heart">settings_heart</button>
</header>
<!-- Main Content Area -->
<main class="flex-1 flex flex-col px-container-padding pt-6 pb-12 relative max-w-lg mx-auto w-full">
<!-- 3D Illustration / Visual Area -->
<div class="w-full aspect-[4/5] rounded-[24px] overflow-hidden diffusion-shadow relative group">
<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-white/40 dark:bg-black/20 glass-bg pointer-events-none"></div>
<img class="w-full h-full object-cover transform transition-transform duration-1000 group-hover:scale-105" data-alt="A premium 3D isometric illustration of a smiling toddler sitting next to holographic growth charts and soft-floating colorful geometric bubbles. The lighting is high-key and studio-quality, with a soft pink ambient glow reflecting off the toddler's pastel-colored clothing. The background is a clean, pressurized white environment with subtle depth, embodying a high-gloss minimalism aesthetic for a luxury infant health brand. Every surface has a pearlescent finish, creating a prestigious and reliable medical-utility feel." src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDi-5gWJg85SEv4Q69PrGbDeHIZHbfc5tPokmXneuIIKVNv6yALhTbNb_rTMjssibgPsIijgL-mc0zIwMaNjvWXIpC71SHRfUwsyxv6uTJu1F96G4sYGwqoZzBqMbVH1BkgPMN0DA5aWXM6yZ6MOrJ8ld16Mryl11yXj-L1FIdxAkQLApCTmbXrxfbPL3aHQyryVcP9rv0r4egRUjd1BOWxUF3bHtqd6ICZS7BcjfP-_uyO9fC3atC5qw">
<!-- IoT Status Chip Overlays -->
<div class="absolute top-6 left-6">
<div class="bg-primary/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse"></span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-primary">LIVE MONITORING</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Text Content -->
<div class="mt-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-4">
<h1 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface tracking-tight">
                Monitor Baby's Growth
            </h1>
<p class="text-secondary font-body-md max-w-[280px]">
                Track weight, height, and head circumference with clinical precision and IoT-enabled precision.
            </p>
</div>
<!-- Spacer -->
<div class="flex-1"></div>
<!-- Bottom Controls -->
<div class="w-full flex flex-col items-center space-y-10">
<!-- Pagination Dots -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<div class="h-2 w-6 rounded-full bg-primary transition-all duration-300"></div>
<div class="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary/20 transition-all duration-300"></div>
<div class="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary/20 transition-all duration-300"></div>
</div>
<!-- Primary Action -->
<button class="w-full h-16 bg-primary text-white font-button-text text-button-text rounded-full vibrant-pink-glow active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200" onclick="handleNext()">
                Next
            </button>
</div>
</main>
<!-- Navigation Shell Placeholder (Suppressed for Onboarding as per Destination Rule) -->
<script>
        function handleNext() {
            // Visual feedback
            const btn = document.querySelector('button');
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">progress_activity</span>';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                console.log("Navigating to next onboarding step...");
                // Navigation logic would go here
                btn.innerHTML = 'Next';
            }, 800);
        }

        // Detect system theme preference
        if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
            // document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        }

        // Micro-interactions for floating effect
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const moveX = (e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) * 0.01;
            const moveY = (e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2) * 0.01;
            const card = document.querySelector('.diffusion-shadow');
            if (card) {
                card.style.transform = `translate3d(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px, 0)`;
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

                    settings_heart
                </span>
</div>

                BabyGrow
            </h1>
<!-- Subtle Loading Indicator (Pill Indicator style from Guidance) -->

<div class="w-8 h-1 bg-primary rounded-full"></div>
<div class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary/20 rounded-full"></div>

<!-- Micro-interaction Script -->
<script>
        // Check for system dark mode preference
        if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        }

        // Simulating the splash transition
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            // After a short delay, we could redirect or transition
            console.log('BabyGrow UI Initialized. Awaiting session...');
            
            // Subtle hover effect for the logo if touched (Mobile friendly)
            const logo = document.querySelector('h1');
            logo.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                logo.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
                logo.style.transition = 'transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)';
            });
            logo.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                logo.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        });

        // Dark mode toggle simulation for demo purposes (can be triggered by system)
        window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', event => {
            if (event.matches) {
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            } else {
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction: Device detection pulse effect
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const scalePod = document.querySelector('.glass-panel');
            
            // Subtle breathing animation for the glass pod
            let scale = 1;
            let growing = true;
            
            function animate() {
                if (growing) {
                    scale += 0.0001;
                    if (scale >= 1.01) growing = false;
                } else {
                    scale -= 0.0001;
                    if (scale <= 0.99) growing = true;
                }
                scalePod.style.transform = `scale(${scale})`;
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            
            animate();
        });

        // Simple dark mode toggle listener (for development/demo purposes)
        // Can be triggered by OS preference or manual toggle if added
        if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
            // document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

<!-- Shader Element -->
<div class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full shader-container">
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_START:ANIMATION_13 class="w-full h-full opacity-90" -->
<div class="w-full h-full opacity-90" style="display:block;">
<canvas id="shader-canvas-ANIMATION_13" style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('shader-canvas-ANIMATION_13');

  // Sync the WebGL drawing-buffer size with the CSS-driven layout size.
  // This fires on initial layout and whenever the element is resized.
  function syncSize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth  || 1280;
    const h = canvas.clientHeight || 720;
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width  = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    new ResizeObserver(syncSize).observe(canvas);
  }
  syncSize();

  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
  if (!gl) return;
  const vs = `attribute vec2 a_position;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
void main() {
  v_texCoord = a_position * 0.5 + 0.5;
  gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
}`;
  const fs = `<webgl-shader>
precision highp float;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;

varying vec2 v_texCoord;

void main() {
    vec2 uv = v_texCoord;
    
    // Wave parameters
    float wave1 = sin(uv.x * 3.0 + u_time * 2.0) * 0.1;
    float wave2 = sin(uv.x * 5.0 - u_time * 1.5) * 0.05;
    float combinedWave = 0.5 + wave1 + wave2;
    
    // Gradient colors derived from #FF007F (Vibrant Pink)
    vec3 pink = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.498);
    vec3 background = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0); // Assume Dark Mode/Transparent base
    
    float alpha = smoothstep(combinedWave - 0.01, combinedWave + 0.01, uv.y);
    vec3 finalColor = mix(pink, pink * 0.4, uv.y);
    
    gl_FragColor = vec4(finalColor, (1.0 - alpha) * 0.3); // Subtle glassmorphism effect
}
</webgl-shader>`;
  function cs(type, src) {
    const s = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl.compileShader(s);
    return s;
  }
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vs));
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs));
  gl.linkProgram(prog);
  gl.useProgram(prog);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const pos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, 'a_position');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(pos);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(pos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_time');
  const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_resolution');
  const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_mouse');

  // u_mouse is in pixel coordinates matching u_resolution (ShaderToy convention).
  // Shaders that need normalized coords should use: u_mouse / u_resolution.
  let mouse = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width && rect.height) {
      const nx = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = 1.0 - (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      mouse.x = nx * canvas.width;
      mouse.y = ny * canvas.height;
    }
  });

  function render(t) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') syncSize();
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uTime) gl.uniform1f(uTime, t * 0.001);
    if (uRes) gl.uniform2f(uRes, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uMouse) gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  render(0);
})();
</script>

                const y = (window.innerHeight / 2 - e.pageY) / 50;
                const container = document.querySelector('main');
                container.style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)`;

                input.type = 'text';
                icon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                icon.textContent = 'visibility';
            }

            document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');

        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input');
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.add('scale-[1.01]');
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.remove('scale-[1.01]');
            });
        });
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_START:ANIMATION_13 class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full" -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full" style="display:block;">
<canvas id="shader-canvas-ANIMATION_13" style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('shader-canvas-ANIMATION_13');

  // Sync the WebGL drawing-buffer size with the CSS-driven layout size.
  // This fires on initial layout and whenever the element is resized.
  function syncSize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth  || 1280;
    const h = canvas.clientHeight || 720;
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width  = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    new ResizeObserver(syncSize).observe(canvas);
  }
  syncSize();

  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
  if (!gl) return;
  const vs = `attribute vec2 a_position;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
void main() {
  v_texCoord = a_position * 0.5 + 0.5;
  gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
}`;
  const fs = `<webgl-shader>
precision highp float;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;

varying vec2 v_texCoord;

void main() {
    vec2 uv = v_texCoord;
    
    // Wave parameters
    float wave1 = sin(uv.x * 3.0 + u_time * 2.0) * 0.1;
    float wave2 = sin(uv.x * 5.0 - u_time * 1.5) * 0.05;
    float combinedWave = 0.5 + wave1 + wave2;
    
    // Gradient colors derived from #FF007F (Vibrant Pink)
    vec3 pink = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.498);
    vec3 background = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0); // Assume Dark Mode/Transparent base
    
    float alpha = smoothstep(combinedWave - 0.01, combinedWave + 0.01, uv.y);
    vec3 finalColor = mix(pink, pink * 0.4, uv.y);
    
    gl_FragColor = vec4(finalColor, (1.0 - alpha) * 0.3); // Subtle glassmorphism effect
}
</webgl-shader>`;
  function cs(type, src) {
    const s = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl.compileShader(s);
    return s;
  }
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vs));
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs));
  gl.linkProgram(prog);
  gl.useProgram(prog);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const pos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, 'a_position');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(pos);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(pos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_time');
  const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_resolution');
  const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_mouse');

  // u_mouse is in pixel coordinates matching u_resolution (ShaderToy convention).
  // Shaders that need normalized coords should use: u_mouse / u_resolution.
  let mouse = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width && rect.height) {
      const nx = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = 1.0 - (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      mouse.x = nx * canvas.width;
      mouse.y = ny * canvas.height;
    }
  });

  function render(t) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') syncSize();
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uTime) gl.uniform1f(uTime, t * 0.001);
    if (uRes) gl.uniform2f(uRes, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uMouse) gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</div>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_END:ANIMATION_13 -->


</body></html>

                Next Step

</button>

                <a class="text-primary font-bold hover:underline" href="#">Log in</a>
</p>

<!-- Background Atmospheric Effect -->
<div class="fixed top-1/4 -right-20 w-64 h-64 bg-primary/5 blur-[100px] -z-10 rounded-full"></div>
<div class="fixed bottom-1/4 -left-20 w-80 h-80 bg-primary/5 blur-[120px] -z-10 rounded-full"></div>
<script>
        // Simple Interaction logic for focus states and micro-animations
        document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.add('ring-1', 'ring-primary/20');
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.remove('ring-1', 'ring-primary/20');
            });
        });

        // Soft scroll/reveal animation logic
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
                    entry.target.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        document.querySelectorAll('.group').forEach((el, index) => {
            el.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'transition-all', 'duration-500');
            el.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 100}ms`;
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        function handleRegistration() {
            // Micro-interaction: Button pulse on click
            const btn = event.currentTarget;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span> Validating...';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">check_circle</span> Profile Verified';
                btn.style.backgroundColor = '#006b17';
                btn.style.boxShadow = '0px 8px 24px rgba(0, 107, 23, 0.3)';
                
                // Add success toast
                const toast = document.createElement('div');
                toast.className = 'fixed top-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-on-surface text-surface px-6 py-3 rounded-full text-sm font-bold shadow-2xl z-[100] flex items-center gap-2 animate-bounce';
                toast.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary">heart_check</span> Welcome to BabyGrow!';
                document.body.appendChild(toast);
            }, 1500);
        }

        // Soft interaction for input focusing
        document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.add('scale-[1.01]');
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.remove('scale-[1.01]');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

</div>
<div class="mt-4">

</div>
<script>
        // Subtle interaction for the primary button
        const primaryBtn = document.querySelector('button.bg-primary');
        primaryBtn.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const rect = primaryBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
            const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
            primaryBtn.style.setProperty('--x', `${x}px`);
            primaryBtn.style.setProperty('--y', `${y}px`);
        });

        // Simple validation visualization
        const inputField = document.querySelector('input');
        inputField.addEventListener('focus', () => {
            inputField.parentElement.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)';
            inputField.parentElement.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s ease';
        });
        inputField.addEventListener('blur', () => {
            inputField.parentElement.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

</header>
<main class="flex-grow flex flex-col items-center justify-start px-container-padding pt-12 pb-24 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full">
<!-- Header Section -->
<div class="w-full text-left mb-12">
<h1 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface mb-2">Enter OTP</h1>

<!-- Box 1 -->
<input class="otp-input w-full aspect-square text-center font-display-lg text-display-lg text-primary bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[24px] border-none diffusion-shadow transition-all duration-300" id="otp1" maxlength="1" oninput="if(this.value.length &gt; 1) this.value = this.value.slice(0, 1); if(this.value.length == 1) this.nextElementSibling?.focus();" type="number">
<!-- Box 2 -->
<input class="otp-input w-full aspect-square text-center font-display-lg text-display-lg text-primary bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[24px] border-none diffusion-shadow transition-all duration-300" id="otp2" maxlength="1" oninput="if(this.value.length &gt; 1) this.value = this.value.slice(0, 1); if(this.value.length == 1) this.nextElementSibling?.focus();" onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Backspace' &amp;&amp; !this.value) this.previousElementSibling?.focus();" type="number">
<!-- Box 3 -->
<input class="otp-input w-full aspect-square text-center font-display-lg text-display-lg text-primary bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[24px] border-none diffusion-shadow transition-all duration-300" id="otp3" maxlength="1" oninput="if(this.value.length &gt; 1) this.value = this.value.slice(0, 1); if(this.value.length == 1) this.nextElementSibling?.focus();" onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Backspace' &amp;&amp; !this.value) this.previousElementSibling?.focus();" type="number">
<!-- Box 4 -->
<input class="otp-input w-full aspect-square text-center font-display-lg text-display-lg text-primary bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[24px] border-none diffusion-shadow transition-all duration-300" id="otp4" maxlength="1" oninput="if(this.value.length &gt; 1) this.value = this.value.slice(0, 1);" onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Backspace' &amp;&amp; !this.value) this.previousElementSibling?.focus();" type="number">
</div>
<!-- Countdown and Logic -->
<div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
<p class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary tracking-widest uppercase">
                    Resend code in <span class="text-primary" id="timer">00:57</span>
</p>
<button class="w-full bg-[#FF007F] text-white font-button-text text-button-text py-5 rounded-full shadow-[0px_0px_20px_rgba(255,0,127,0.3)] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-200" id="verifyBtn">
                    Verify
                </button>

                    Change Email
                </button>

<!-- Visual Atmosphere: Subtle background element -->
<div class="fixed top-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[300px] h-[300px] rounded-full bg-primary/5 blur-[120px] pointer-events-none -z-10"></div>
<div class="fixed bottom-[5%] left-[-5%] w-[250px] h-[250px] rounded-full bg-primary/10 blur-[100px] pointer-events-none -z-10"></div>
<script>
        // Simple Countdown Logic
        let timeLeft = 59;
        const timerDisplay = document.getElementById('timer');
        
        const countdown = setInterval(() => {
            if (timeLeft <= 0) {
                clearInterval(countdown);
                timerDisplay.textContent = "00:00";
                timerDisplay.parentElement.innerHTML = '<a href="#" class="text-primary underline">Resend Code</a>';
            } else {
                timeLeft--;
                const seconds = timeLeft < 10 ? '0' + timeLeft : timeLeft;
                timerDisplay.textContent = `00:${seconds}`;
            }
        }, 1000);

        // Auto-focus first input
        window.onload = () => {
            document.getElementById('otp1').focus();
        };

        // Micro-interaction for Verify Button
        document.getElementById('verifyBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            this.classList.add('scale-95');
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.classList.remove('scale-95');
                // Placeholder for logic
                const code = document.getElementById('otp1').value + 
                             document.getElementById('otp2').value + 
                             document.getElementById('otp3').value + 
                             document.getElementById('otp4').value;
                if(code.length === 4) {
                    this.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">refresh</span>';
                }
            }, 150);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Password visibility toggle logic
        const togglePassword = document.querySelector('#togglePassword');
        const password = document.querySelector('#password');
        const eyeIcon = document.querySelector('#eyeIcon');

        togglePassword.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            const type = password.getAttribute('type') === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
            password.setAttribute('type', type);
            eyeIcon.textContent = type === 'password' ? 'visibility' : 'visibility_off';
        });

        // Micro-interaction for input fields
        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input');
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary/10');
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.parentElement.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary/10');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

                Try Again
            </button>
<!-- Secondary Action (Ghost Button) -->
<button class="w-full bg-transparent text-primary py-4 rounded-full font-button-text text-button-text active:scale-[0.98] transition-all hover:bg-primary/5" onclick="handleForgot()">
                Forgot Password
            </button>
</div>
<!-- IoT Status Chip (Contextual feedback for network mention) -->
<div class="mt-12 flex items-center gap-2 bg-primary/10 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px] text-primary" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">wifi_off</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-primary">Check network settings</span>
</div>
</main>
<!-- Micro-interactions Script -->
<script>
        function handleRetry() {
            // Visual feedback for interaction
            const btn = event.currentTarget;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span>';
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = 'Try Again';
            }, 1500);
        }

        function handleForgot() {
            // Animation for transition
            document.body.style.opacity = '0.5';
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.body.style.opacity = '1';
            }, 300);
        }

        // Add subtle parallax to the icon on mouse move for desktop
        if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                const icon = document.querySelector('img');
                const x = (window.innerWidth / 2 - e.pageX) / 40;
                const y = (window.innerHeight / 2 - e.pageY) / 40;
                icon.style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)`;
            });
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

<!-- Micro-interaction Script -->
<script>
        // Simple confetti-like sparkle effect on load
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const container = document.body;
            for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                const sparkle = document.createElement('div');
                sparkle.className = 'absolute pointer-events-none bg-primary/20 rounded-full blur-[1px]';
                const size = Math.random() * 8 + 4;
                sparkle.style.width = `${size}px`;
                sparkle.style.height = `${size}px`;
                sparkle.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
                sparkle.style.top = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
                sparkle.style.opacity = '0';
                
                container.appendChild(sparkle);
                
                const delay = Math.random() * 2;
                sparkle.animate([
                    { transform: 'translateY(0) scale(0)', opacity: 0 },
                    { transform: `translateY(-${Math.random() * 100 + 50}px) scale(1)`, opacity: 0.6, offset: 0.5 },
                    { transform: `translateY(-200px) scale(0)`, opacity: 0 }
                ], {
                    duration: 3000 + Math.random() * 2000,
                    delay: delay * 1000,
                    iterations: Infinity
                });
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

                Save Password

<script>
        function togglePassword(id) {
            const input = document.getElementById(id);
            const icon = input.nextElementSibling.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
            if (input.type === 'password') {
                input.type = 'text';
                icon.innerText = 'visibility_off';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                icon.innerText = 'visibility';
            }
        }

        // Mock Strength Logic
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('newPassword');
        const strengthBar = document.getElementById('strengthBar');
        const strengthText = document.getElementById('strengthText');

        passwordInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const val = e.target.value;
            let strength = 0;
            
            if (val.length > 0) strength = 20;
            if (val.length > 5) strength = 45;
            if (val.length > 8) strength = 75;
            if (val.length > 10 && /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(val)) strength = 100;

            strengthBar.style.width = strength + '%';
            
            if (strength <= 25) {
                strengthText.innerText = 'STRENGTH: TOO WEAK';
                strengthBar.className = 'strength-bar h-full bg-error shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(186,26,26,0.3)]';
            } else if (strength <= 50) {
                strengthText.innerText = 'STRENGTH: WEAK';
                strengthBar.className = 'strength-bar h-full bg-primary-container shadow-[0_0_10px_#FF007F]';
            } else if (strength <= 75) {
                strengthText.innerText = 'STRENGTH: GOOD';
                strengthBar.className = 'strength-bar h-full bg-primary-container shadow-[0_0_10px_#FF007F]';
            } else {
                strengthText.innerText = 'STRENGTH: STRONG';
                strengthBar.className = 'strength-bar h-full bg-tertiary shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,107,23,0.3)]';
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

                header.classList.add('shadow-[0px_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]');
            } else {
                header.classList.remove('shadow-[0px_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]');
            }
        };

        // Micro-interactions for buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function() {
                this.classList.add('scale-95');

            btn.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
                this.classList.remove('scale-95');
            });
        });

</div>

<!-- Moving hand animation via JS/CSS -->
<div class="absolute w-1 h-10 md:h-12 bg-primary rounded-full origin-bottom" id="clock-hand" style="bottom: 50%; transform: rotate(0deg);"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Typography Section -->
<div class="max-w-md space-y-6">
<h1 class="font-display-lg text-display-lg text-on-background tracking-tight">
                Session Expired
            </h1>
<p class="text-secondary font-body-md leading-relaxed px-4 opacity-80">
                For security reasons, your session has ended. Please log in again to continue managing data.
            </p>
</div>

<footer class="p-container-padding pb-12 flex flex-col items-center gap-stack-gap w-full max-w-lg mx-auto relative z-10">

            Log In Again
        </button>
<a class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary/60 hover:text-primary transition-colors tracking-widest uppercase" href="#">
            Switch Account
        </a>
</footer>
<!-- Artistic Background Elements (2026 Glamorism) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[50%] h-[50%] bg-primary-container/5 rounded-full blur-[100px] pointer-events-none"></div>
<script>
        // Micro-interaction for the clock hand
        const clockHand = document.getElementById('clock-hand');
        let rotation = 0;
        
        function animateClock() {
            rotation = (rotation + 0.5) % 360;
            clockHand.style.transform = `rotate(${rotation}deg)`;
            requestAnimationFrame(animateClock);
        }
        
        animateClock();

        // Button interaction
        const loginBtn = document.getElementById('login-button');
        loginBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            loginBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin" data-icon="progress_activity">progress_activity</span>';
            setTimeout(() => {
                // Mock redirect
                console.log('Redirecting to login...');
                window.location.reload();
            }, 800);
        });

        // Subtle parallax on mouse move for desktop
        if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                const moveX = (e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) / 50;
                const moveY = (e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2) / 50;
                document.querySelector('.icon-floating').style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px)`;
            });
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

                header.classList.add('diffusion-shadow');
                header.classList.remove('bg-surface/80');
                header.classList.add('bg-white');
            } else {
                header.classList.remove('diffusion-shadow');
                header.classList.add('bg-surface/80');
                header.classList.remove('bg-white');
            }
        });

        // Search Interaction
        const searchInput = document.querySelector('input');
        searchInput.addEventListener('focus', () => {
            searchInput.parentElement.classList.add('scale-[1.02]');
        });
        searchInput.addEventListener('blur', () => {
            searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('scale-[1.02]');

<style>

            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0px 10px 20px rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.3);
        }

        .inactive-pill {
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
            color: #5c3f46;

<body class="font-body-md text-body-md min-h-screen flex flex-col">
<!-- Top Bar Navigation (Transactional Screen - No Global Nav) -->
<header class="fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl h-20 flex items-center px-container-padding">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto">
<button aria-label="Close" class="p-2 -ml-2 active:scale-95 transition-transform">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-on-surface text-[28px]">close</span>
</button>
<h1 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface">Filter Data</h1>
<button class="font-button-text text-secondary active:opacity-60 transition-opacity">
                Reset
            </button>
</div>
</header>
<!-- Main Content Canvas -->
<main class="flex-grow pt-24 pb-32 px-container-padding max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full">
<!-- Category 1: Age Group -->
<section class="mb-section-margin">
<div class="mb-4">
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary uppercase tracking-widest">Age Group</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-element-gap">
<button class="active-pill w-full h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-button-text text-lg transition-all duration-300" onclick="togglePill(this)">
                    0-6 Months
                </button>
<button class="inactive-pill w-full h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-button-text text-lg transition-all duration-300" onclick="togglePill(this)">
                    6-24 Months
                </button>
<button class="inactive-pill w-full h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-button-text text-lg transition-all duration-300" onclick="togglePill(this)">
                    24-60 Months
                </button>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Category 2: Nutrition Status -->
<section class="mb-section-margin">
<div class="mb-4">
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary uppercase tracking-widest">Nutrition Status</span>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-element-gap">
<button class="active-pill h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-button-text transition-all duration-300" onclick="togglePill(this)">
                    Normal
                </button>
<button class="inactive-pill h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-button-text transition-all duration-300" onclick="togglePill(this)">
                    Risk of Stunting
                </button>
<button class="inactive-pill h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-button-text transition-all duration-300 col-span-2 md:col-span-1" onclick="togglePill(this)">
                    Stunting
                </button>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Category 3: Neighborhood (RT/RW) -->
<section class="mb-section-margin">
<div class="mb-4">
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary uppercase tracking-widest">Neighborhood (RT/RW)</span>
</div>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-16 px-6 rounded-full glass-input text-on-surface placeholder:text-secondary/40 focus:ring-0 focus:shadow-[0px_0px_0px_2px_rgba(255,0,127,0.2)] transition-shadow duration-300" placeholder="Search by RT or RW number..." type="text"/>
<div class="absolute right-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary/40">location_on</span>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Atmospheric Visual Element (Bento-style info card) -->
<div class="rounded-[24px] bg-white diffusion-shadow p-6 flex items-center gap-4 border-none">
<div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">info</span>
</div>
<div>
<p class="font-body-md text-on-surface font-semibold">Active Monitoring</p>
<p class="text-sm text-secondary">Filters will affect the global nursery dashboard and health analytics.</p>
</div>
</div>
</main>
<!-- Bottom Action Button (Sticky) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-container-padding bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-2xl z-50">
<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
<button class="w-full h-16 bg-[#FF007F] text-white rounded-full font-button-text text-lg pink-glow-shadow active:scale-95 active:opacity-90 transition-all duration-300">
                Apply Filter
            </button>
</div>
</div>
<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for pill toggling
        function togglePill(element) {
            // Logic: In a multi-select context we toggle. For this demo, let's keep it toggleable.
            if (element.classList.contains('active-pill')) {
                element.classList.remove('active-pill');
                element.classList.add('inactive-pill');
            } else {
                element.classList.remove('inactive-pill');
                element.classList.add('active-pill');
            }
        }

        // Add subtle scroll reveal logic if needed, but keeping it clean for now.
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const header = document.querySelector('header');
            if (window.scrollY > 20) {
                header.classList.add('shadow-sm');
            } else {
                header.classList.remove('shadow-sm');
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<!-- Shader -->
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_START:ANIMATION_37 class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full" -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full" style="display:block;">
<canvas id="shader-canvas-ANIMATION_37" style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('shader-canvas-ANIMATION_37');

  // Sync the WebGL drawing-buffer size with the CSS-driven layout size.
  // This fires on initial layout and whenever the element is resized.
  function syncSize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth  || 1280;
    const h = canvas.clientHeight || 720;
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width  = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    new ResizeObserver(syncSize).observe(canvas);
  }
  syncSize();

  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
  if (!gl) return;
  const vs = `attribute vec2 a_position;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
void main() {
  v_texCoord = a_position * 0.5 + 0.5;
  gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
}`;
  const fs = `precision highp float;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;

void main() {
    vec2 uv = (v_texCoord - 0.5) * 2.0;
    uv.x *= u_resolution.x / u_resolution.y;
    
    float d = length(uv);
    
    // Create concentric pulsing waves
    float wave1 = sin(d * 15.0 - u_time * 4.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    float wave2 = sin(d * 8.0 - u_time * 2.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    
    // Fade waves based on distance
    float alpha = smoothstep(0.8, 0.0, d) * 0.3;
    
    // Combine waves and apply color #FF007F (Vibrant Pink)
    vec3 color = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.498);
    float intensity = pow(wave1 * wave2, 2.0) * alpha;
    
    // Add a central glow
    float centerGlow = 0.05 / d;
    intensity += centerGlow * 0.5;
    
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, intensity * smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, d));
}`;
  function cs(type, src) {
    const s = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl.compileShader(s);
    return s;
  }
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vs));
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs));
  gl.linkProgram(prog);
  gl.useProgram(prog);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const pos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, 'a_position');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(pos);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(pos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_time');
  const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_resolution');
  const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_mouse');

  // u_mouse is in pixel coordinates matching u_resolution (ShaderToy convention).
  // Shaders that need normalized coords should use: u_mouse / u_resolution.
  let mouse = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width && rect.height) {
      const nx = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = 1.0 - (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      mouse.x = nx * canvas.width;
      mouse.y = ny * canvas.height;
    }
  });

  function render(t) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') syncSize();
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uTime) gl.uniform1f(uTime, t * 0.001);
    if (uRes) gl.uniform2f(uRes, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uMouse) gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</div>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_END:ANIMATION_37 -->


</body></html>

</button>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for the sync button
        const syncBtn = document.getElementById('syncTrigger');
        const weightVal = document.getElementById('weightVal');
        const heightVal = document.getElementById('heightVal');
        const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');

        syncBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            statusText.innerText = "SYNCING DATA...";
            statusText.classList.add('text-primary');
            
            // Simulating IoT Data Fetch
            setTimeout(() => {
                let w = 12.4;
                let h = 88.0;
                
                const interval = setInterval(() => {
                    w = (parseFloat(w) + 0.1).toFixed(1);
                    h = (parseFloat(h) + 0.05).toFixed(1);
                    weightVal.innerText = w;
                    heightVal.innerText = h;
                }, 50);

                setTimeout(() => {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    weightVal.innerText = "13.2";
                    heightVal.innerText = "89.5";
                    statusText.innerText = "DATA SYNCED SUCCESSFULLY";
                    statusText.classList.remove('animate-pulse-soft');
                    
                    // Simple tactile feedback simulation
                    syncBtn.classList.add('bg-primary/10');
                    setTimeout(() => syncBtn.classList.remove('bg-primary/10'), 200);
                }, 1000);
            }, 800);
        });
    </script>

<!-- Hidden Bottom Nav suppression as per "Task-Focused" rule for details pages -->
<!-- But keeping the structure ready if user navigated away -->
<script>
        // Micro-interaction for the "Back" button
        document.querySelector('button:has(span:contains("arrow_back"))')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.history.back();
        });

        // Scroll listener for TopAppBar shadow transition
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const header = document.querySelector('header');
            if (window.scrollY > 20) {
                header.classList.add('shadow-[0px_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]');
                header.classList.remove('bg-white/80');
                header.classList.add('bg-white/95');
            } else {
                header.classList.remove('shadow-[0px_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]');
                header.classList.add('bg-white/80');
                header.classList.remove('bg-white/95');
            }
        });

        // Add a subtle parallax to the avatar on move
        const avatar = document.querySelector('.w-32.h-32');
        if (avatar) {
            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                const moveX = (e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) / 100;
                const moveY = (e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2) / 100;
                avatar.style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px)`;
            });
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

<!-- WebGL Background Shader: Immersive Scanning Waves -->
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_START:ANIMATION_37 class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full z-0 pointer-events-none opacity-40" -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full z-0 pointer-events-none opacity-40" style="display:block;">
<canvas id="shader-canvas-ANIMATION_37" style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('shader-canvas-ANIMATION_37');

  // Sync the WebGL drawing-buffer size with the CSS-driven layout size.
  // This fires on initial layout and whenever the element is resized.
  function syncSize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth  || 1280;
    const h = canvas.clientHeight || 720;
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width  = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    new ResizeObserver(syncSize).observe(canvas);
  }
  syncSize();

  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
  if (!gl) return;
  const vs = `attribute vec2 a_position;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
void main() {
  v_texCoord = a_position * 0.5 + 0.5;
  gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
}`;
  const fs = `precision highp float;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;

void main() {
    vec2 uv = (v_texCoord - 0.5) * 2.0;
    uv.x *= u_resolution.x / u_resolution.y;
    
    float d = length(uv);
    
    // Create concentric pulsing waves
    float wave1 = sin(d * 15.0 - u_time * 4.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    float wave2 = sin(d * 8.0 - u_time * 2.0) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    
    // Fade waves based on distance
    float alpha = smoothstep(0.8, 0.0, d) * 0.3;
    
    // Combine waves and apply color #FF007F (Vibrant Pink)
    vec3 color = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.498);
    float intensity = pow(wave1 * wave2, 2.0) * alpha;
    
    // Add a central glow
    float centerGlow = 0.05 / d;
    intensity += centerGlow * 0.5;
    
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, intensity * smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, d));
}`;
  function cs(type, src) {
    const s = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl.compileShader(s);
    return s;
  }
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vs));
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs));
  gl.linkProgram(prog);
  gl.useProgram(prog);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const pos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, 'a_position');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(pos);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(pos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_time');
  const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_resolution');
  const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_mouse');

  // u_mouse is in pixel coordinates matching u_resolution (ShaderToy convention).
  // Shaders that need normalized coords should use: u_mouse / u_resolution.
  let mouse = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width && rect.height) {
      const nx = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = 1.0 - (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      mouse.x = nx * canvas.width;
      mouse.y = ny * canvas.height;
    }
  });

  function render(t) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') syncSize();
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uTime) gl.uniform1f(uTime, t * 0.001);
    if (uRes) gl.uniform2f(uRes, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uMouse) gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</div>

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            console.log("BabyGrow Bluetooth Scanner initialized.");
            
            // Micro-interaction for the cancel button
            const cancelBtn = document.querySelector('a');
            cancelBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                cancelBtn.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
            });
            cancelBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                cancelBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });

            // Randomly update status text to feel "live"
            const statusText = document.querySelector('.animate-status-pulse');
            const phases = [
                "Looking for ESP32 hardware...",
                "Polling Bluetooth peripherals...",
                "Checking signal strength...",
                "Filtering BabyGrow devices..."
            ];
            let currentPhase = 0;

            setInterval(() => {
                currentPhase = (currentPhase + 1) % phases.length;
                statusText.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    statusText.textContent = phases[currentPhase];
                    statusText.style.opacity = '1';
                }, 500);
            }, 6000);
        });
    </script>

<!-- Micro-interaction Script -->
<script>
        const buttons = [
            { id: 'status-healthy', icon: 'sentiment_satisfied', label: 'Healthy' },
            { id: 'status-fever', icon: 'thermostat', label: 'Fever' },
            { id: 'status-flu', icon: 'medical_mask', label: 'Cough/Flu' }
        ];

        buttons.forEach(btnInfo => {
            const el = document.getElementById(btnInfo.id);
            el.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Reset all
                buttons.forEach(otherBtn => {
                    const otherEl = document.getElementById(otherBtn.id);
                    otherEl.className = "w-full h-20 rounded-full bg-white diffusion-shadow text-secondary flex items-center px-8 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]";
                    // Remove check icon if exists
                    const check = otherEl.querySelector('[data-icon="check_circle"]');
                    if (check) check.remove();
                });

                // Set Active
                el.className = "relative w-full h-20 rounded-full bg-primary text-white pink-glow flex items-center px-8 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]";
                
                const checkIcon = document.createElement('span');
                checkIcon.className = "material-symbols-outlined ml-auto";
                checkIcon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'check_circle');
                checkIcon.setAttribute('style', "font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;");
                checkIcon.innerText = "check_circle";
                el.appendChild(checkIcon);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

        btn.classList.remove('opacity-90');

        document.querySelectorAll('.diffusion-shadow').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('click', function() {
                // Remove active state from all
                document.querySelectorAll('.animate-pulse-pink').forEach(p => p.remove());
                document.querySelectorAll('.diffusion-shadow').forEach(c => {
                    c.classList.remove('border-2', 'border-primary/10', 'relative');
                });
                
                // Add to clicked (simulated)
                const pulse = document.createElement('div');
                pulse.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-primary/5 animate-pulse-pink';
                this.classList.add('border-2', 'border-primary/10', 'relative');
                this.appendChild(pulse);
            });
        });

<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for the cancel button
        document.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => {
            // In a real app, this would navigate back or trigger a cancel flow
            console.log('Connection cancelled');
            document.body.style.opacity = '0.5';
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.history.back();
            }, 300);
        });

        // Simulating connection states for visual feedback
        const messages = [
            "Please keep your phone close to the scale.",
            "Waking up the sensor...",
            "Synchronizing health data tokens...",
            "Optimizing Bluetooth channel..."
        ];
        let currentMsg = 0;
        const msgElement = document.querySelector('p');

        setInterval(() => {
            currentMsg = (currentMsg + 1) % messages.length;
            msgElement.style.opacity = 0;
            setTimeout(() => {
                msgElement.textContent = messages[currentMsg];
                msgElement.style.opacity = 1;
            }, 400);
        }, 4000);
    </script>
</body></html>

<div class="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0" id="particle-container"></div>
<script>
        // Simple confetti effect for celebration
        const container = document.getElementById('particle-container');
        const colors = ['#FF007F', '#ffd9e1', '#b60059', '#e30071'];

        function createParticle() {
            const particle = document.createElement('div');
            particle.className = 'confetti-particle';
            
            const size = Math.random() * 8 + 4;
            const startX = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
            
            particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
            particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
            particle.style.backgroundColor = color;
            particle.style.left = `${startX}px`;
            particle.style.top = `-20px`;
            
            container.appendChild(particle);

            const duration = Math.random() * 3000 + 2000;
            const endX = startX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200;
            const endY = window.innerHeight + 20;

            const animation = particle.animate([
                { transform: `translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg)`, opacity: 1 },
                { transform: `translate(${endX - startX}px, ${endY}px) rotate(${Math.random() * 720}deg)`, opacity: 0 }
            ], {
                duration: duration,
                easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)'
            });

            animation.onfinish = () => particle.remove();
        }

        // Trigger particles on load
        for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
            setTimeout(createParticle, Math.random() * 2000);
        }
        
        // Continuous subtle flow
        setInterval(createParticle, 400);

        // Micro-interaction for the button
        const btn = document.querySelector('button');
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Ripple effect or pulse on success
            for(let i=0; i<15; i++) createParticle();
            btn.innerHTML = 'Initialising...';
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = 'Scale Ready';
            }, 800);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simulated live data stream from ESP32
        const weightDisplay = document.getElementById('weight-display');
        const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-btn');
        let currentWeight = 0.00;
        let isIncreasing = true;

        function simulateWeight() {
            // Logic to simulate breathing/fluctuation or weight being added
            if (currentWeight < 3.45) {
                currentWeight += Math.random() * 0.15;
            } else {
                // Subtle oscillation once weight is detected
                currentWeight += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
            }

            weightDisplay.textContent = currentWeight.toFixed(2);

            // Update button state
            if (currentWeight > 0.5) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.classList.remove('bg-secondary/20', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                confirmBtn.classList.add('bg-primary', 'shadow-[0px_10px_20px_rgba(182,0,89,0.3)]', 'active:scale-95');
            } else {
                confirmBtn.disabled = true;
                confirmBtn.classList.add('bg-secondary/20', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                confirmBtn.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'shadow-[0px_10px_20px_rgba(182,0,89,0.3)]', 'active:scale-95');
            }
        }

        // Run simulation every 150ms for that "live" digital feel
        const simulationInterval = setInterval(simulateWeight, 150);

        // Interaction logic
        confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if(!confirmBtn.disabled) {
                confirmBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin" data-icon="sync">sync</span>';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    confirmBtn.innerHTML = 'Saved Successfully';
                    confirmBtn.classList.remove('bg-primary');
                    confirmBtn.classList.add('bg-tertiary');
                }, 1000);
            }
        });
    </script>

<script>
        function simulateSync() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('sync-btn');
            const weightVal = document.getElementById('weight-value');
            
            btn.classList.add('sync-active', 'bg-primary', 'text-white');
            btn.innerHTML = `
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin" data-icon="autorenew">autorenew</span>
                Syncing...
            `;

            // Visual feedback for numbers changing
            let counter = 0;
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                weightVal.innerText = (12.4 + (Math.random() * 0.2)).toFixed(1);
                counter++;
                if (counter > 20) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    weightVal.innerText = "12.6";
                    btn.classList.remove('sync-active', 'bg-primary', 'text-white');
                    btn.innerHTML = `
                        <span class="material-symbols-outlined" data-icon="check_circle">check_circle</span>
                        Synced Successfully
                    `;
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        btn.innerHTML = `
                            <span class="material-symbols-outlined" data-icon="sync">sync</span>
                            Sync from Scale
                        `;
                    }, 3000);
                }
            }, 100);
        }

        // Handle numeric inputs and active states
        document.getElementById('height-input').addEventListener('focus', function() {
            this.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('pink-glow-shadow');
            this.parentElement.parentElement.style.transform = 'scale(1.02)';
        });
        document.getElementById('height-input').addEventListener('blur', function() {
            this.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('pink-glow-shadow');
            this.parentElement.parentElement.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
        });
    </script>

                account_circle
            </button>

</header>
<main class="pt-24 pb-32 px-container-padding max-w-md mx-auto flex flex-col gap-stack-gap h-screen">
<!-- Screen Header -->
<div class="mb-4">
<h2 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-primary">Scale Health</h2>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
<span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-tertiary"></span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary uppercase tracking-widest">System Operational</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Centerpiece: Elegant Battery Pod -->
<div class="glass-pod diffusion-shadow rounded-[24px] p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden flex-1 max-h-[460px]">
<!-- Battery Glass Shape -->
<div class="relative w-32 h-64 border-4 border-primary/10 rounded-[32px] p-1.5 overflow-hidden shadow-inner flex flex-col justify-end">
<!-- Battery Tip -->
<div class="absolute -top-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-8 h-2 bg-primary/10 rounded-t-lg"></div>
<!-- Fluid Fill -->
<div class="battery-fill-animation w-full bg-primary rounded-[24px] relative" id="battery-level" style="height: 85%;">
<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/10 to-white/20"></div>
<!-- Bubbles/Particles for extra flair -->
<div class="absolute top-2 left-4 w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-white/40"></div>
<div class="absolute top-6 right-6 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-white/20"></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Percentage Display -->
<div class="mt-8 text-center">
<span class="font-display-lg text-primary block leading-none" id="percentage-text">85%</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary/60 mt-1 uppercase">Remaining Power</span>
</div>
<!-- Subtle Pink Glow behind the battery -->
<div class="absolute -z-10 w-48 h-48 bg-primary/5 blur-3xl rounded-full"></div>
</div>
<!-- Info Section: Status List -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
<div class="glass-pod diffusion-shadow rounded-[24px] p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 20px;">timer</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-label-caps text-[10px] text-secondary/60 uppercase">Uptime</span>
<span class="font-button-text text-on-surface">14d 06h 22m</span>
</div>
</div>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary/30">chevron_right</span>
</div>
<div class="glass-pod diffusion-shadow rounded-[24px] p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 20px;">signal_cellular_alt</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-label-caps text-[10px] text-secondary/60 uppercase">Signal Strength</span>
<span class="font-button-text text-on-surface">-54 dBm (Excellent)</span>
</div>
</div>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary/30">chevron_right</span>
</div>
<div class="glass-pod diffusion-shadow rounded-[24px] p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 20px;">sync</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-label-caps text-[10px] text-secondary/60 uppercase">Last Sync Time</span>
<span class="font-button-text text-on-surface">Just now</span>
</div>
</div>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary/30">chevron_right</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- IoT Status Chip -->
<div class="flex justify-center mt-2">
<div class="px-4 py-2 bg-primary/10 text-primary font-label-caps text-label-caps rounded-full flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse"></span>
                SCALE CONNECTED
            </div>
</div>
</main>
<!-- BottomNavBar -->
<nav class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[92%] rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-2xl flex justify-around items-center p-2 z-50 no-border">
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-secondary/60 px-6 py-2 hover:bg-white/30 transition-all active:scale-90 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">insights</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Live</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-secondary/60 px-6 py-2 hover:bg-white/30 transition-all active:scale-90 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">balance</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Calibrate</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-primary bg-white/40 rounded-full px-6 py-2 transition-all active:scale-90 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">battery_charging_full</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Battery</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-secondary/60 px-6 py-2 hover:bg-white/30 transition-all active:scale-90 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">history</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">History</span>
</a>
</nav>
<script>
        // Micro-interaction: Animated Percentage Loading
        window.onload = () => {
            const level = document.getElementById('battery-level');
            const text = document.getElementById('percentage-text');
            let count = 0;
            const target = 85;
            
            // Set final height
            level.style.height = target + '%';
            
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                if (count >= target) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                } else {
                    count++;
                    text.innerText = count + '%';
                }
            }, 15);
        };
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for feedback on button press
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const icon = this.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.style.transform = 'scale(1.2)';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        icon.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                    }, 200);
                }
            });
        });

        // Sticky header logic
        let lastScroll = 0;
        const header = document.querySelector('header');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
            if (currentScroll > 50) {
                header.classList.add('py-1');
            } else {
                header.classList.remove('py-1');
            }
            lastScroll = currentScroll;
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        const tareButton = document.getElementById('tareButton');
        const buttonStatic = document.getElementById('buttonStatic');
        const buttonActive = document.getElementById('buttonActive');
        const calibrationSuccess = document.getElementById('calibrationSuccess');

        tareButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Start calibration state
            buttonStatic.classList.add('opacity-0', 'scale-90');
            buttonActive.classList.remove('hidden');
            calibrationSuccess.classList.add('hidden');

            // Simulate hardware delay
            setTimeout(() => {
                // Show success
                buttonStatic.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'scale-90');
                buttonActive.classList.add('hidden');
                
                calibrationSuccess.classList.remove('hidden');
                
                // Vibrate if available (Haptic feedback)
                if (window.navigator.vibrate) {
                    window.navigator.vibrate(200);
                }

                // Hide success message after 3 seconds
                setTimeout(() => {
                    calibrationSuccess.classList.add('hidden');
                }, 3000);
            }, 2500);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('1')">1</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('2')">2</button>

<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('4')">4</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('5')">5</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('6')">6</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('7')">7</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('8')">8</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('9')">9</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('.')">.</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-background diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="addNum('0')">0</button>
<button class="num-button h-16 glass-pod rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-primary diffusion-shadow transition-all" onclick="backspace()">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-3xl">backspace</span>
</button>
