<!-- Footer Action -->
<footer class="w-full px-container-padding pb-safe mb-8 max-w-md">
<button class="w-full h-16 bg-primary text-white rounded-full font-button-text text-button-text diffusion-shadow active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none" disabled="" id="confirm-btn">
            Confirm Height
        </button>
</footer>
<script>
        let currentInput = "";
        const display = document.getElementById('height-value');
        const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-btn');

        function addNum(val) {
            // Logic to prevent multiple decimals and cap length
            if (val === '.' && currentInput.includes('.')) return;
            if (currentInput.length >= 5) return;
            
            // Limit to 1 decimal place for precision UI logic
            if (currentInput.includes('.') && currentInput.split('.')[1].length >= 1) return;

            currentInput += val;
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function backspace() {
            currentInput = currentInput.slice(0, -1);
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function updateDisplay() {
            if (currentInput === "") {
                display.textContent = "--.-";
                confirmBtn.disabled = true;
            } else {
                display.textContent = currentInput;
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
            }
            
            // Simple validation: enable button only if input looks like a real number
            const val = parseFloat(currentInput);
            if (!isNaN(val) && val > 0) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.classList.add('shadow-[0px_10px_30px_rgba(182,0,89,0.3)]');
            } else {
                confirmBtn.disabled = true;
                confirmBtn.classList.remove('shadow-[0px_10px_30px_rgba(182,0,89,0.3)]');
            }
        }

        // Tactile Haptic Simulation
        const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.num-button, #confirm-btn');
        buttons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                if ('vibrate' in navigator) {
                    navigator.vibrate(10);
                }
            });
        });

        // Background Atmosphere Micro-interactions
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const moveX = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 10;
            const moveY = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 10;
            document.querySelector('.glass-pod').style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px)`;
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

        // Micro-interaction: Subtle parallax on the background glows

            const y = e.clientY / window.innerHeight;

            glows.forEach((glow, index) => {
                const speed = (index + 1) * 20;
                glow.style.transform = `translate(${x * speed}px, ${y * speed}px)`;
            });
        });

        // Button interaction logic
        const reconnectBtn = document.querySelector('button');
        reconnectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            reconnectBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span>';
            setTimeout(() => {
                reconnectBtn.innerHTML = 'Reconnect';
            }, 2000);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

        // Micro-interaction for scroll effects
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const topBar = document.querySelector('nav:first-of-type');
            if (window.scrollY > 20) {
                topBar.classList.add('shadow-lg');
                topBar.classList.replace('bg-white/80', 'bg-white/95');
            } else {
                topBar.classList.remove('shadow-lg');
                topBar.classList.replace('bg-white/95', 'bg-white/80');
            }
        });

        // Add staggered animation to settings items
        document.querySelectorAll('button.glass-card').forEach((el, i) => {
            el.style.opacity = '0';
            el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                el.style.transition = 'all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';
                el.style.opacity = '1';
                el.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            }, i * 100 + 300);
        });
    </script>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for calibration button
        const calibrateBtn = document.querySelector('button.bg-primary');
        calibrateBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const originalText = calibrateBtn.innerText;
            calibrateBtn.innerText = 'Calibrating...';
            calibrateBtn.style.opacity = '0.7';
            calibrateBtn.disabled = true;
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                calibrateBtn.innerText = 'Calibration Complete';
                calibrateBtn.style.backgroundColor = '#008820'; // Success color from config
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    calibrateBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    calibrateBtn.style.backgroundColor = '#b60059'; // Reset to primary
                    calibrateBtn.style.opacity = '1';
                    calibrateBtn.disabled = false;
                }, 2000);
            }, 3000);
        });

        // Toggle Dark Mode (Optional utility for demo)
        function toggleTheme() {
            document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

        // Subtle haptic-like micro-interactions
        document.querySelectorAll('button, a').forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                if (window.navigator.vibrate) window.navigator.vibrate(5);
            });
        });

        // Dynamic background effect for 2026 Glamorism aesthetic
        const addGrain = () => {
            const grain = document.createElement('div');
            grain.style.position = 'fixed';
            grain.style.top = '0';
            grain.style.left = '0';
            grain.style.width = '100%';
            grain.style.height = '100%';
            grain.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            grain.style.zIndex = '9999';
            grain.style.opacity = '0.02';
            grain.style.background = `url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")`;
            document.body.appendChild(grain);
        };
        addGrain();
    </script>
</body></html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_START:ANIMATION_71 class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full" -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full" style="display:block;">
<canvas id="shader-canvas-ANIMATION_71" style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('shader-canvas-ANIMATION_71');

  // Sync the WebGL drawing-buffer size with the CSS-driven layout size.
  // This fires on initial layout and whenever the element is resized.
  function syncSize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth  || 1280;
    const h = canvas.clientHeight || 720;
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width  = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    new ResizeObserver(syncSize).observe(canvas);
  }
  syncSize();

  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
  if (!gl) return;
  const vs = `attribute vec2 a_position;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
void main() {
  v_texCoord = a_position * 0.5 + 0.5;
  gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
}`;
  const fs = `precision highp float;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;

void main() {
    vec2 uv = v_texCoord;
    vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5);
    float d = length(uv - center);
    
    // Create a soft, breathing pink glow
    float breathing = (sin(u_time * 1.5) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.15;
    float glow = smoothstep(0.4 + breathing, 0.0, d);
    
    // Mix vibrant pink (#FF007F) with white
    vec3 pink = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.498);
    vec3 color = mix(vec3(1.0), pink, glow);
    
    // Add some subtle noise-like movement
    float noise = sin(uv.x * 10.0 + u_time) * cos(uv.y * 10.0 + u_time) * 0.02;
    color += noise * glow;

    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}`;
  function cs(type, src) {
    const s = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl.compileShader(s);
    return s;
  }
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vs));
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs));
  gl.linkProgram(prog);
  gl.useProgram(prog);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const pos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, 'a_position');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(pos);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(pos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_time');
  const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_resolution');
  const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_mouse');

  // u_mouse is in pixel coordinates matching u_resolution (ShaderToy convention).
  // Shaders that need normalized coords should use: u_mouse / u_resolution.
  let mouse = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width && rect.height) {
      const nx = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = 1.0 - (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      mouse.x = nx * canvas.width;
      mouse.y = ny * canvas.height;
    }
  });

  function render(t) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') syncSize();
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uTime) gl.uniform1f(uTime, t * 0.001);
    if (uRes) gl.uniform2f(uRes, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uMouse) gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</div>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_END:ANIMATION_71 -->
</body>
</html>

<head>

<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;

      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;

<body>
<!-- STITCH_THREEJS_START:ANIMATION_72 class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full bg-transparent" -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full bg-transparent" style="display:block;">
<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/threejs/r125/three.min.js"></script>
<div id="threejs-container-ANIMATION_72" style="width:100%;height:100%"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  const container = document.getElementById('threejs-container-ANIMATION_72');
  const devicePixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, 1, 0.1, 1000);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });

const width = container.clientWidth || 390;
const height = container.clientHeight || 390;
renderer.setSize(width, height);
renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

// Create a premium, glassmorphic torus knot as the "abstract 3D element"
const geometry = new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(1, 0.3, 128, 32);
const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
    color: 0xFF007F,
    specular: 0xffffff,
    shininess: 100,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.8
});

const torusKnot = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
scene.add(torusKnot);

const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
light.position.set(5, 5, 5);
scene.add(light);

const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
scene.add(ambientLight);

camera.position.z = 4;

function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    torusKnot.rotation.x += 0.01;
    torusKnot.rotation.y += 0.01;
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    const w = container.clientWidth;
    const h = container.clientHeight;
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(w, h);
});

animate();
})();
</script>
</div>
<!-- STITCH_THREEJS_END:ANIMATION_72 -->
</body>
</html>

<body class="font-body-md text-on-background min-h-screen flex flex-col relative">
<!-- Global Navigation Suppressed for Onboarding Flow per PRD -->
<!-- Animated Shader Background -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 z-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_START:ANIMATION_71 class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-60" -->
<div class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-60" style="display:block;">
<canvas id="shader-canvas-ANIMATION_71" style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('shader-canvas-ANIMATION_71');

  // Sync the WebGL drawing-buffer size with the CSS-driven layout size.
  // This fires on initial layout and whenever the element is resized.
  function syncSize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth  || 1280;
    const h = canvas.clientHeight || 720;
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width  = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    new ResizeObserver(syncSize).observe(canvas);
  }
  syncSize();

  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
  if (!gl) return;
  const vs = `attribute vec2 a_position;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
void main() {
  v_texCoord = a_position * 0.5 + 0.5;
  gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
}`;
  const fs = `precision highp float;
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;

void main() {
    vec2 uv = v_texCoord;
    vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5);
    float d = length(uv - center);
    
    // Create a soft, breathing pink glow
    float breathing = (sin(u_time * 1.5) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.15;
    float glow = smoothstep(0.4 + breathing, 0.0, d);
    
    // Mix vibrant pink (#FF007F) with white
    vec3 pink = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.498);
    vec3 color = mix(vec3(1.0), pink, glow);
    
    // Add some subtle noise-like movement
    float noise = sin(uv.x * 10.0 + u_time) * cos(uv.y * 10.0 + u_time) * 0.02;
    color += noise * glow;

    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}`;
  function cs(type, src) {
    const s = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl.compileShader(s);
    return s;
  }
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vs));
  gl.attachShader(prog, cs(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs));
  gl.linkProgram(prog);
  gl.useProgram(prog);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const pos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, 'a_position');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(pos);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(pos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_time');
  const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_resolution');
  const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'u_mouse');

  // u_mouse is in pixel coordinates matching u_resolution (ShaderToy convention).
  // Shaders that need normalized coords should use: u_mouse / u_resolution.
  let mouse = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width && rect.height) {
      const nx = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = 1.0 - (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      mouse.x = nx * canvas.width;
      mouse.y = ny * canvas.height;
    }
  });

  function render(t) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') syncSize();
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uTime) gl.uniform1f(uTime, t * 0.001);
    if (uRes) gl.uniform2f(uRes, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (uMouse) gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</div>
<!-- STITCH_SHADER_END:ANIMATION_71 -->

<script>
(function() {
  const container = document.getElementById('threejs-container-ANIMATION_72');
  const devicePixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, 1, 0.1, 1000);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });

const width = container.clientWidth || 390;
const height = container.clientHeight || 390;
renderer.setSize(width, height);
renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

// Create a premium, glassmorphic torus knot as the "abstract 3D element"
const geometry = new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(1, 0.3, 128, 32);
const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
    color: 0xFF007F,
    specular: 0xffffff,
    shininess: 100,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.8
});

const torusKnot = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
scene.add(torusKnot);

const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
light.position.set(5, 5, 5);
scene.add(light);

const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
scene.add(ambientLight);

camera.position.z = 4;

function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    torusKnot.rotation.x += 0.01;
    torusKnot.rotation.y += 0.01;
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    const w = container.clientWidth;
    const h = container.clientHeight;
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(w, h);
});

animate();
})();
</script>

        });

        // Soft entry animation for text elements
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const elements = document.querySelectorAll('h1, p, button');

                el.style.transition = 'all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';
                
                setTimeout(() => {

                    el.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, 200 + (index * 100));
            });
        });

<canvas class="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0 opacity-40" id="particleCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
        // Simple ambient particle animation
        const canvas = document.getElementById('particleCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let particles = [];

        function initCanvas() {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }

        class Particle {
            constructor() {
                this.reset();
            }
            reset() {
                this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
                this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
                this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
                this.speedX = Math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1;
                this.speedY = Math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1;
                this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.5;
            }
            update() {
                this.x += this.speedX;
                this.y += this.speedY;
                if (this.x < 0 || this.x > canvas.width || this.y < 0 || this.y > canvas.height) {
                    this.reset();
                }
            }
            draw() {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(182, 0, 89, ${this.opacity})`;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        function createParticles() {
            for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
                particles.push(new Particle());
            }
        }

        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            particles.forEach(p => {
                p.update();
                p.draw();
            });
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', initCanvas);
        initCanvas();
        createParticles();
        animate();

        // Interaction logic for Notify me
        document.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function() {
            this.innerHTML = 'Saved! <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">check_circle</span>';
            this.classList.add('text-tertiary');
            this.classList.remove('text-primary');
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for Retry Button
        document.getElementById('retry-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            const btn = this;
            const originalContent = btn.innerHTML;
            
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">refresh</span> Reconnecting...';
            btn.classList.add('opacity-80');
            btn.disabled = true;

            // Simulate reconnection attempt
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = originalContent;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-80');
                btn.disabled = false;
                // In a real app, logic to check navigator.onLine would go here
            }, 2000);
        });

        // Suppress BottomNavBar Logic if needed (per mandate, this is a top-level state "Offline Mode" 
        // that still needs access to status/profile, so it stays visible for now as a destination 
        // unless specified otherwise)
    </script>

<script>
        function createConfetti() {
            const container = document.body;
            const colors = ['#FF007F', '#ff4d94', '#ffffff', '#e2e2e2'];
            
            for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
                const particle = document.createElement('div');
                particle.className = 'confetti-particle';
                
                const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
                const size = Math.random() * 8 + 4;
                const left = Math.random() * 100;
                const duration = Math.random() * 3 + 2;
                const delay = Math.random() * 2;
                
                particle.style.left = `${left}vw`;
                particle.style.top = `-20px`;
                particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
                particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
                particle.style.backgroundColor = color;
                particle.style.opacity = Math.random();
                
                container.appendChild(particle);

                const animation = particle.animate([
                    { transform: 'translateY(0) rotate(0deg)', opacity: 1 },
                    { transform: `translateY(105vh) rotate(${Math.random() * 360}deg)`, opacity: 0 }
                ], {
                    duration: duration * 1000,
                    delay: delay * 1000,
                    easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)',
                    iterations: 1
                });

                animation.onfinish = () => particle.remove();
            }
        }

        // Trigger on load
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            setTimeout(createConfetti, 500);
        });

        // Interactive button effect
        document.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => {
            createConfetti();
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simple Interaction logic for demo
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const icon = btn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                if (icon && icon.textContent === 'delete_outline') {
                    const card = btn.closest('.bg-surface');
                    card.style.opacity = '0.5';
                    card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
                    
                    const toast = document.getElementById('deleteToast');
                    toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
                    toast.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
                    
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
                        toast.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
                        card.style.opacity = '1';
                        card.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                    }, 2000);
                }
            });
        });

        // Background movement effect
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
            const background = document.querySelector('webgl-shader');
            if(background) {
                background.style.transform = `translateY(${scrolled * 0.1}px)`;
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<body class="bg-surface font-body-md text-on-surface overflow-hidden h-screen flex flex-col">
<!-- Top AppBar (Identity Anchor) -->
<!-- According to Shell Rules: TopAppBar is kept for brand anchoring, but navigation is suppressed for this focused task -->
<header class="fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-xl h-16 flex items-center justify-center px-container-padding">
<h1 class="font-display-lg text-[24px] text-primary tracking-tighter font-extrabold">LuminaCare</h1>
</header>
<!-- Main Content Canvas (Safety Confirmation) -->
<main class="flex-grow flex items-center justify-center px-container-padding relative">
<!-- Subtle Atmospheric Background Detail (2026 Glamorism) -->
<div class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden">
<div class="absolute -top-[10%] -left-[10%] w-[50%] h-[50%] bg-primary/5 rounded-full blur-[120px]"></div>
<div class="absolute -bottom-[10%] -right-[10%] w-[40%] h-[40%] bg-tertiary/5 rounded-full blur-[120px]"></div>
</div>
<!-- Warning Pod (Bento/Card) -->
<div class="w-full max-w-md glass-morphism rounded-3xl p-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center diffusion-shadow z-10 animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-700">
<!-- 3D Caution Icon -->
<div class="relative w-48 h-48 mb-8">
<!-- Floating Effect Animation Container -->
<div class="animate-bounce" style="animation-duration: 4s; animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;">
<img alt="A premium, minimalist 3D caution or warning icon. A soft, glassmorphic exclamation mark or triangle floating over a soft, vibrant pink (#FF007F) glowing sphere. Highly diffused shadows, clean studio lighting on a pristine white background. 8k resolution, professional healthcare tech aesthetic." class="w-full h-full object-contain drop-shadow-[0px_20px_30px_rgba(255,0,127,0.2)]" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuBexuuYgcstGau2RMLh-_9V4Ywz9w70nL-GlxDVoZrQ3y71sSQcL4IT_7cIDfC1tacq6TlYcaewvooyHhQYogLR1bqq7HsIgBKiZFErQ_PeIpbcbJaNt8w9MCZwXC9xIBomtwOYWnLNnBg0diidXIeYRzpqTSaeCxXBUn0jWQjraKHaRYWiJlpQ8nwbw8T_QkvdouSHUHPVemsn3cFHIbTjtepb_gk9Fu2KR8Lynoa6jvtaTxzokCRLpA"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Warning Copy -->
<div class="space-y-4 mb-10">
<h2 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface">
                    Warning
                </h2>
<p class="text-on-surface-variant font-body-md leading-relaxed px-2">
                    Are you sure you want to delete this measurement? This action <span class="font-bold text-primary">cannot be undone</span>.
                </p>
</div>
<!-- Action Cluster -->
<div class="w-full space-y-stack-gap">
<!-- Primary Action -->
<button class="btn-hover-effect w-full py-4 bg-primary text-white rounded-full font-button-text pink-glow-shadow flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]" style="font-variation-settings: 'wght' 600;">delete_forever</span>
                    Yes, Delete
                </button>
<!-- Secondary Ghost Action -->
<button class="btn-hover-effect w-full py-3 bg-transparent text-secondary font-button-text hover:bg-surface-container-high/50 rounded-full">
                    Cancel
                </button>
</div>
</div>
</main>
<!-- Success Message Snackbar (Hidden by default, used for interaction demo) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 glass-morphism px-8 py-4 rounded-full diffusion-shadow translate-y-32 opacity-0 transition-all duration-500 z-[100] flex items-center gap-3" id="toast">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary">check_circle</span>
<span class="font-button-text text-on-surface">Action processed successfully</span>
</div>
<script>
        // Simple Interaction Logic for prototyping feel
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const isDelete = e.currentTarget.innerText.includes('Delete');
                const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
                
                if (isDelete) {
                    e.currentTarget.innerHTML = `<span class="animate-spin material-symbols-outlined">sync</span> Processing...`;
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        toast.classList.remove('translate-y-32', 'opacity-0');
                        e.currentTarget.innerHTML = `<span class="material-symbols-outlined">delete_forever</span> Yes, Delete`;
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            toast.classList.add('translate-y-32', 'opacity-0');
                        }, 3000);
                    }, 1500);
                } else {
                    // Logic for cancel (go back)
                    window.history.back();
                }
            });
        });

        // Atmospheric parallax on mouse move (Desktop only)
        if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                const moveX = (e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) / 50;
                const moveY = (e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2) / 50;
                const card = document.querySelector('.glass-morphism');
                card.style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px)`;
            });
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simple scroll reveal for timeline items
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.style.opacity = "1";
                    entry.target.style.transform = "translateY(0)";
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        document.querySelectorAll('.group').forEach(item => {
            item.style.opacity = "0";
            item.style.transform = "translateY(20px)";
            item.style.transition = "all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)";
            observer.observe(item);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<p class="font-body-md text-body-md leading-relaxed">
                    Stunting is the impaired growth and development that children experience from poor nutrition, repeated infection, and inadequate psychosocial stimulation. It is a critical metric for long-term health and cognitive capability.
                </p>
<div class="w-full h-64 my-8 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden diffusion-shadow">

<h3 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface pt-4">The Long-term Impact</h3>
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md leading-relaxed">
                    The consequences of stunting can last a lifetime. Children who are stunted often experience diminished physical growth, reduced cognitive development, and a higher risk of chronic diseases in adulthood. By monitoring specific markers through Lumina Health, we provide real-time insights to intervene before these patterns become permanent.
                </p>
<div class="bg-surface-container-low p-6 rounded-3xl border-l-4 border-primary mt-6">
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md italic text-on-surface-variant">
                        "The first 1,000 days of life are the most critical window for ensuring a child reaches their full potential. Prevention is not just about height; it's about neurodevelopment."
                    </p>
</div>
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md leading-relaxed">
                    Our IoT sensors track rhythmic vitals and metabolic indicators, ensuring that your child's growth trajectory remains within the optimal range. This proactive approach transforms reactive medical care into predictive wellness management.

        // Subtle entrance animation for the content
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const article = document.querySelector('article');
            article.style.opacity = '0';
            article.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                article.style.transition = 'all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';
                article.style.opacity = '1';
                article.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            }, 100);
        });

        // Feedback Button Interaction
        const feedbackButtons = document.querySelectorAll('button');
        feedbackButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                if(this.innerText.includes('Yes') || this.innerText.includes('No')) {
                    const originalContent = this.innerHTML;
                    this.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">check_circle</span> Thanks!';
                    this.classList.add('bg-tertiary', 'text-white');
                    this.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-primary');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        this.innerHTML = originalContent;
                        this.classList.remove('bg-tertiary', 'text-white');
                        if(this.innerText.includes('Yes')) this.classList.add('bg-primary');
                    }, 2000);
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>
        // Micro-interactions for search focus
        const searchInput = document.querySelector('input');
        searchInput.addEventListener('focus', () => {
            searchInput.parentElement.classList.add('scale-[1.02]');
        });
        searchInput.addEventListener('blur', () => {
            searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('scale-[1.02]');
        });

        // Toggle user status on card click (Visual Demo Only)
        document.querySelectorAll('.diffusion-shadow').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const statusLabel = card.querySelector('span.uppercase');
                const pill = card.querySelector('.active-pill, .bg-surface-dim');
                
                if (statusLabel.innerText === 'ACTIVE') {
                    statusLabel.innerText = 'INACTIVE';
                    statusLabel.classList.replace('bg-primary/10', 'bg-secondary-container');
                    statusLabel.classList.replace('text-primary', 'text-secondary');
                    pill.className = 'w-6 h-1.5 bg-surface-dim rounded-full transition-all duration-300';
                    card.classList.add('opacity-80', 'grayscale-[0.5]');
                } else {
                    statusLabel.innerText = 'ACTIVE';
                    statusLabel.classList.replace('bg-secondary-container', 'bg-primary/10');
                    statusLabel.classList.replace('text-secondary', 'text-primary');
                    pill.className = 'active-pill transition-all duration-300';
                    card.classList.remove('opacity-80', 'grayscale-[0.5]');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for toggles
        document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-checkbox').forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('change', function() {
                const parent = this.closest('.bg-white');
                if(this.checked) {
                    parent.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
                    setTimeout(() => parent.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20'), 400);
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>
        // Micro-interactions for KPI cards
        document.querySelectorAll('.glass-card').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)';
                card.style.transition = 'transform 0.2s ease-out';
            });
            card.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        });

        // Simple visibility effect on scroll
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1
        };
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
                    entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        document.querySelectorAll('.glass-card').forEach(card => {
            card.style.opacity = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            card.style.transition = 'all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';
            observer.observe(card);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-secondary uppercase">Emergency Status</span>

</div>

</div>
<!-- Contact Setup Form -->

<div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
<label class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant ml-4">PRIMARY CONTACT NAME</label>
<input class="glass-input h-14 rounded-full px-6 font-body-md text-on-surface placeholder:text-secondary/40 shadow-sm" placeholder="e.g., Posyandu Lead" type="text"/>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
<label class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant ml-4">PHONE NUMBER</label>
<input class="glass-input h-14 rounded-full px-6 font-body-md text-on-surface placeholder:text-secondary/40 shadow-sm" placeholder="+62 812-3456-7890" type="tel"/>

<option>Pediatrician</option>
<option>Family Member</option>
<option>Neighbor</option>
</select>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none text-secondary">expand_more</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Automation Settings Pod -->
<div class="diffusion-shadow bg-white rounded-[24px] p-6 flex items-center justify-between animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-12 duration-1000">
<div class="flex flex-col gap-1">

</div>
</div>
<!-- Image Reference Pod -->

<img class="w-full h-full object-cover" data-alt="A cinematic, high-end photography shot of a sleek white Lumina baby monitoring device on a marble nursery side table. <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/40 to-transparent flex items-end p-6">

</div>
</div>
<!-- Emergency Ghost Button -->
<div class="mt-8 mb-4 px-2">
<button class="w-full h-16 rounded-full border-2 border-primary bg-transparent text-primary font-button-text text-button-text active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-primary/5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">emergency_share</span>
                EMERGENCY CALL
            </button>
</div>
</main>

<!-- Growth -->

</a>
<!-- Schedule -->

<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">notifications_active</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps mt-1">Schedule</span>
</a>
<!-- SOS (ACTIVE) -->
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-primary font-bold scale-110 transition-all active:scale-90 duration-200" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">emergency_share</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps mt-1">SOS</span>
</a>
</nav>
<!-- JavaScript for Micro-interactions -->
<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Toggle Switch Micro-interaction
            const toggle = document.querySelector('.w-14.h-8');
            const knob = toggle?.querySelector('div');
            let isActive = true;

            toggle?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                isActive = !isActive;
                if (isActive) {
                    toggle.classList.remove('bg-secondary/20');
                    toggle.classList.add('bg-primary');
                    knob.classList.add('translate-x-6');
                } else {
                    toggle.classList.remove('bg-primary');
                    toggle.classList.add('bg-secondary/20');
                    knob.classList.remove('translate-x-6');
                }
            });

            // Focus animation for inputs
            const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('.glass-input');
            inputs.forEach(input => {
                input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                    input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('scale-[1.02]');
                    input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('transition-transform');
                });
                input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                    input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('scale-[1.02]');
                });
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for device items
        document.querySelectorAll('.glass-morphic').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)';
            });
            card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            });
        });

        // Simulating real-time status update for the syncing item
        const syncingLabel = document.querySelector('.animate-syncing .text-secondary');
        let progress = 42;
        setInterval(() => {
            if (syncingLabel) {
                progress = (progress + 1) % 100;
                syncingLabel.textContent = `UPDATING ${progress}%`;
            }
        }, 1000);
    </script>

            btn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.96)';
            });
            btn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                btn.style.transform = '';
            });
            btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {

<script>
        function togglePicker(id) {
            const picker = document.getElementById(id);
            const isHidden = picker.classList.contains('hidden');
            
            // Close all other pickers first for focus
            document.querySelectorAll('[id^="picker-"]').forEach(p => p.classList.add('hidden'));
            
            if (isHidden) {
                picker.classList.remove('hidden');
                picker.classList.add('animate-in', 'fade-in', 'slide-in-from-top-2');
            }
        }

        // Add ripple effect or micro-interaction feedback
        document.querySelectorAll('.glass-card').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(0.995)';
            });
            card.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
            card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                this.classList.add('scale-95');
                setTimeout(() => this.classList.remove('scale-95'), 100);
            });
        });

        // Horizontal scroll for chips if needed, but here we only have one.
        // Atmospheric subtle mouse follow shadow effect for cards
        document.querySelectorAll('.bg-white.rounded-\\[24px\\]').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
                const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
                card.style.setProperty('--mouse-x', `${x}px`);
                card.style.setProperty('--mouse-y', `${y}px`);
            });
        });
    </script>

</a>

<span class="material-symbols-outlined">emergency</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps mt-1">SOS</span>
</a>

<!-- Interactive Layer for UX Flourish -->
<script>
        document.querySelector('button:last-of-type').addEventListener('click', () => {
            if(confirm('Are you sure you want to clear the local cache? Un-synced data will be lost.')) {
                alert('Cache cleared successfully.');
                location.reload();
            }
        });

        document.querySelector('button:first-of-type').addEventListener('click', function() {
            const btn = this;
            const originalContent = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span> Synchronizing...';
            btn.classList.add('opacity-80');
            btn.disabled = true;

            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">check_circle</span> Sync Complete';
                btn.classList.remove('bg-primary');
                btn.classList.add('bg-tertiary');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerHTML = originalContent;
                    btn.classList.remove('bg-tertiary');
                    btn.classList.add('bg-primary');
                    btn.classList.remove('opacity-80');
                    btn.disabled = false;
                }, 2000);
            }, 3000);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

</button>

                    Submit Report
                </button>
<p class="text-center font-label-caps text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant/60 mt-6 px-8 leading-relaxed uppercase">

<!-- Success Toast (Hidden by default) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[90%] max-w-sm p-4 rounded-2xl bg-on-background text-white flex items-center gap-4 diffusion-shadow translate-y-32 transition-transform duration-500 z-50" id="successToast">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-white">check</span>
</div>
<div>
<p class="font-bold text-sm">Report Sent Successfully</p>
<p class="text-xs opacity-70">Our team is reviewing your feedback.</p>
</div>
</div>
<script>
        // Simple Interaction Logic
        function selectType(btn) {
            // Reset others
            const buttons = btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button');
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-white');
                b.classList.add('bg-white/40', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            });
            // Set current
            btn.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-white');
            btn.classList.remove('bg-white/40', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        }

        const form = document.getElementById('feedbackForm');
        const toast = document.getElementById('successToast');

        form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            // Interaction feedback
            const submitBtn = e.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
            const originalText = submitBtn.innerText;
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.innerHTML = `<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">progress_activity</span>`;

            setTimeout(() => {
                submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                
                // Show success toast
                toast.classList.remove('translate-y-32');
                toast.classList.add('translate-y-0');
                
                // Clear form
                document.getElementById('description').value = '';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    toast.classList.add('translate-y-32');
                    toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0');
                }, 3000);
            }, 1200);
        });

        // Atmospheric micro-interaction: subtle mouse glow effect (if on desktop)
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const body = document.body;
            const x = e.clientX;
            const y = e.clientY;
            // No direct mutation, but can be used for CSS variable based lighting if needed
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interactions for the cards
        document.querySelectorAll('.diffusion-shadow').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)';
                card.style.transition = 'transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)';
            });
            card.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                card.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        });

        // Floating particle effect for "Glamorism" aesthetic
        const createParticle = () => {
            const particle = document.createElement('div');
            particle.className = 'fixed rounded-full bg-primary/5 pointer-events-none z-[-1]';
            const size = Math.random() * 100 + 50;
            particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
            particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
            particle.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}vw`;
            particle.style.top = `${Math.random() * 100}vh`;
            particle.style.filter = 'blur(40px)';
            document.body.appendChild(particle);

            const animation = particle.animate([
                { transform: 'translate(0, 0)', opacity: 0 },
                { transform: `translate(${Math.random() * 100 - 50}px, ${Math.random() * 100 - 50}px)`, opacity: 0.3 },
                { transform: 'translate(0, 0)', opacity: 0 }
            ], {
                duration: 10000 + Math.random() * 5000,
                iterations: Infinity
            });
        };

        for(let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            createParticle();
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

                    Log Out
                </button>
<!-- Secondary Action: Stay Logged In -->
<button class="w-full h-[64px] rounded-full font-button-text text-button-text text-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-pink/5 transition-colors active-scale" onclick="handleStay()">
                    Stay Logged In

<!-- Micro-interaction Scripts -->
<script>
        function handleLogout() {
            // Visual feedback before navigation
            const btn = event.currentTarget;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2"><svg class="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"></circle><path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path></svg> Logging out...</span>';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                console.log("Logged out successfully");
                // In a real app, window.location.href = '/login';
            }, 800);
        }

        function handleStay() {
            // Simple return interaction
            const main = document.querySelector('main');
            main.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)';
            main.style.opacity = '0';
            main.style.transition = 'all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                console.log("Navigation back to dashboard");
                // In a real app, window.history.back();
            }, 300);
        }

        // Parallax effect on mouse move for the background glow
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const glow = document.querySelector('.pink-glow-bg');
            const x = e.clientX / window.innerWidth;
            const y = e.clientY / window.innerHeight;
            
            glow.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at ${x * 100}% ${y * 100}%, rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.05) 0%, rgba(249, 249, 249, 0) 70%)`;
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        function changeTheme(mode) {
            const preview = document.getElementById('theme-preview');
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.theme-card');
            
            // Remove active classes
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('active-ring');
                card.querySelector('.check-mark').classList.add('hidden');
            });

            // Update Preview & Body Class
            if (mode === 'light') {
                preview.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
                preview.querySelectorAll('div, span').forEach(el => {
                    if (el.classList.contains('bg-on-background/10')) el.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
                });
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            } else if (mode === 'dark') {
                preview.style.backgroundColor = '#1a1c1c';
                preview.querySelectorAll('div, span').forEach(el => {
                    if (el.classList.contains('bg-on-background/10')) el.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
                });
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            } else if (mode === 'high-contrast') {
                preview.style.backgroundColor = '#000000';
                preview.querySelectorAll('div, span').forEach(el => {
                    if (el.classList.contains('bg-on-background/10')) el.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
                });
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            }

            // Find clicked card
            const eventTarget = event.currentTarget;
            eventTarget.classList.add('active-ring');
            eventTarget.querySelector('.check-mark').classList.remove('hidden');
            
            // Haptic feedback feel
            eventTarget.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
            setTimeout(() => eventTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)', 100);
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

<span class="material-symbols-outlined" data-icon="emergency">emergency</span>

<script>
    // Micro-interactions for toggles
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-checkbox').forEach(checkbox => {
      checkbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
        const label = this.nextElementSibling;
        const dot = label.nextElementSibling;
        
        if (this.checked) {
          label.classList.replace('bg-surface-container-highest', 'bg-primary');
          dot.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
          dot.classList.replace('bg-secondary-fixed-dim', 'bg-white');
        } else {
          label.classList.replace('bg-primary', 'bg-surface-container-highest');
          dot.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
          dot.classList.replace('bg-white', 'bg-secondary-fixed-dim');
        }
      });
    });

    // Initialize initial states for JS-controlled toggles
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-checkbox').forEach(checkbox => {
      const label = checkbox.nextElementSibling;
      const dot = label.nextElementSibling;
      if (checkbox.checked) {
        label.classList.add('bg-primary');
        dot.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
        dot.classList.add('bg-white');
      } else {
        label.classList.add('bg-surface-container-highest');
        dot.classList.add('bg-secondary-fixed-dim');
      }
    });
  </script>
</body></html>

<style>
        body {
            background-color: #f9f9f9;
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
        }

        .ambient-glow {
            position: absolute;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.08) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%);
            filter: blur(60px);
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .glow-top-left { top: -200px; left: -200px; }
        .glow-bottom-right { bottom: -200px; right: -200px; }

        .baby-glow-aura {
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.4));
            animation: pulse-aura 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-aura {
            0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.3)); transform: scale(1); }
            50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 45px rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.6)); transform: scale(1.02); }
        }

        .fade-in-up {
            animation: fadeInUp 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
        }

        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .glass-button {
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

<!-- Micro-interaction Script -->
<script>
        function handleStart() {
            // Visual feedback for interaction
            const btn = document.querySelector('.glass-button');
            btn.style.opacity = '0.7';
            
            // Log for state transition (internal use)
            console.log("Navigating to Onboarding...");
            
            // In a real app, this would trigger a route change
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.style.opacity = '1';
                // Simulation of navigation flash
                document.body.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease-out';
                document.body.style.opacity = '0';
            }, 300);
        }

        // Mouse parallax effect for ambient glows
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) - 0.5;
            const y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight) - 0.5;
            
            const glows = document.querySelectorAll('.ambient-glow');
            glows.forEach((glow, index) => {
                const speed = (index + 1) * 20;
                glow.style.transform = `translate(${x * speed}px, ${y * speed}px)`;
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        function selectLanguage(element) {
            // Remove active state from all
            document.querySelectorAll('button.glass-card').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.remove('active-glow');
                btn.classList.add('diffusion-shadow');
                
                const indicator = btn.querySelector('.rounded-full:last-child');
                indicator.className = 'w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-secondary opacity-20';
                indicator.innerHTML = '';

                const iconBox = btn.querySelector('.w-12.h-12');
                iconBox.classList.replace('bg-primary/10', 'bg-secondary/5');
                iconBox.querySelector('span').classList.replace('text-primary', 'text-secondary');
                iconBox.querySelector('span').style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 0";
            });

            // Set active state
            element.classList.remove('diffusion-shadow');
            element.classList.add('active-glow');
            
            const indicator = element.querySelector('.rounded-full:last-child');
            indicator.className = 'w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center animate-pulse';
            indicator.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[16px]">check</span>';

            const iconBox = element.querySelector('.w-12.h-12');
            iconBox.classList.replace('bg-secondary/5', 'bg-primary/10');
            iconBox.querySelector('span').classList.replace('text-secondary', 'text-primary');
            iconBox.querySelector('span').style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 1";
        }
    </script>
</body></html>

<body class="font-body-md text-body-md antialiased overflow-x-hidden">
<!-- Top App Bar -->
<header class="fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-xl flex justify-between items-center px-container-padding h-16 shadow-[0px_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]">

<span class="material-symbols-outlined">arrow_back</span>
</button>
<h1 class="font-display-lg text-headline-lg-mobile tracking-tighter text-primary">Emergency Protocol</h1>
</div>
<button class="active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 text-primary">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">account_circle</span>
</button>
</header>
<!-- Main Content Canvas -->
<main class="pt-24 pb-32 px-container-padding flex flex-col gap-stack-gap min-h-screen">
<!-- Instructional Intro -->
<div class="mb-4">
<p class="text-secondary font-body-md">Follow these steps immediately if your BabyGrow device triggers a critical alert.</p>
</div>
<!-- Step 1 Card -->
<div class="glass-card diffusion-shadow rounded-[24px] p-6 flex items-start gap-6 border-none transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-white/80">
<div class="flex-shrink-0">
<span class="font-display-lg text-[48px] text-primary-container leading-none">1</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
<h2 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface">Check Oximetry</h2>
<p class="text-secondary">Verify the sock fitment on your infant's foot and confirm the oxygen saturation levels on the dashboard.</p>
<div class="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 bg-primary/10 text-primary rounded-full w-fit">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">monitoring</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">LIVE SENSOR DATA</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Step 2 Card -->
<div class="glass-card diffusion-shadow rounded-[24px] p-6 flex items-start gap-6 border-none transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-white/80">
<div class="flex-shrink-0">
<span class="font-display-lg text-[48px] text-primary-container leading-none">2</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
<h2 class="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface">Stay Calm</h2>
<p class="text-secondary">Take a deep breath. Your baby reacts to your stress. Approach the crib gently and assess for responsiveness.</p>

        // Micro-interaction for cards to appear in sequence
        document.querySelectorAll('.glass-card').forEach((card, index) => {
            card.style.opacity = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                card.style.transition = 'all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';
                card.style.opacity = '1';
                card.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            }, 100 * index);
        });

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                button.classList.add('opacity-70');
            });
            button.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                button.classList.remove('opacity-70');
            });
        });

        // Simple visibility observer for scroll-in effects
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
                    entry.target.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        document.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(el => {
            el.classList.add('transition-all', 'duration-700', 'opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

                    Submit Feedback
                </button>

                Back to Dashboard
            </button>

<!-- Visual Polish: Soft Ambient Glow -->
<div class="fixed top-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[300px] h-[300px] rounded-full bg-primary/5 blur-[100px] -z-10 pointer-events-none"></div>
<div class="fixed bottom-[-10%] left-[-10%] w-[300px] h-[300px] rounded-full bg-primary/5 blur-[100px] -z-10 pointer-events-none"></div>
<script>
        const stars = document.querySelectorAll('.star-btn');
        let currentRating = 0;

        stars.forEach(star => {
            star.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const value = parseInt(star.getAttribute('data-value'));
                currentRating = value;
                updateStars(value);
            });
        });

        function updateStars(value) {
            stars.forEach(star => {
                const starVal = parseInt(star.getAttribute('data-value'));
                const icon = star.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                if (starVal <= value) {
                    icon.classList.add('active-star');
                    icon.classList.remove('text-outline-variant');
                } else {
                    icon.classList.remove('active-star');
                    icon.classList.add('text-outline-variant');
                }
            });
        }

        function submitFeedback() {
            const surveyContent = document.getElementById('survey-content');
            const successScreen = document.getElementById('success-screen');

            // Haptic feedback simulation
            if (window.navigator && window.navigator.vibrate) {
                window.navigator.vibrate(50);
            }

            surveyContent.classList.add('fade-out');
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                surveyContent.style.display = 'none';
                successScreen.classList.add('active');
            }, 400);
        }

        // Auto-focus textarea interaction feel
        document.querySelector('#comments').addEventListener('focus', () => {
            const pod = document.querySelector('#comments').closest('.glass-pod');
            pod.style.boxShadow = '0px 20px 60px rgba(182, 0, 89, 0.08)';
            pod.style.transition = 'box-shadow 0.3s ease';
        });

        document.querySelector('#comments').addEventListener('blur', () => {
            const pod = document.querySelector('#comments').closest('.glass-pod');
            pod.style.boxShadow = '0px 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)';
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

          },

    </script>

<p class="text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">
                    Our IoT smart cameras process facial recognition locally on-device. No video streams are analyzed in the cloud for marketing purposes. You have the power to define "Blackout Zones" where recording is physically disabled at the hardware level.
                </p>
</div>

<div class="mt-8 space-y-stack-gap">

<h4 class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-primary uppercase mb-1">Retention Policy</h4>
<p class="text-on-surface-variant text-sm">Account data is held for the duration of your active subscription and deleted 90 days after account termination unless otherwise requested.</p>
</div>

<h4 class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-primary uppercase mb-1">Parental Controls</h4>
<p class="text-on-surface-variant text-sm">Primary account holders have full "Right to be Forgotten" controls within the app settings, allowing for one-tap data wiping.</p>
</div>
<div class="border-l-4 border-primary/20 pl-4 py-2">
<h4 class="font-label-caps text-label-caps text-primary uppercase mb-1">Global Compliance</h4>

<!-- Fixed Bottom Action Bar -->
<footer class="fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 glass-panel p-container-padding flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-t-xl shadow-[0px_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]">
<div class="flex items-start gap-3">
<input class="mt-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-md border-outline-variant text-primary focus:ring-primary transition-colors cursor-pointer" id="agree-check" type="checkbox"/>
<label class="text-sm text-on-surface-variant leading-tight" for="agree-check">
                I have read and agree to the <span class="text-primary font-bold">Terms of Service</span> and <span class="text-primary font-bold">Data Processing Agreement</span>.
            </label>
</div>
<button class="w-full bg-primary text-white font-button-text text-button-text py-4 rounded-full pink-glow-shadow active:scale-95 transition-all hover:opacity-90" onclick="handleAgree()">
            Agree &amp; Continue
        </button>
</footer>
<script>
        function handleAgree() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('agree-check');
            if (!checkbox.checked) {
                checkbox.parentElement.classList.add('animate-shake');
                setTimeout(() => checkbox.parentElement.classList.remove('animate-shake'), 400);
                return;
            }
            
            // Interaction feedback
            const btn = event.currentTarget;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span>';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = 'Success';
                btn.classList.replace('bg-primary', 'bg-tertiary-container');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    alert('Privacy Policy Accepted. Welcome to Lumina Baby.');
                }, 500);
            }, 1200);
        }

        // Add shake animation
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
            @keyframes shake {
                0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
                25% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
                75% { transform: translateX(5px); }
            }
            .animate-shake {
                animation: shake 0.2s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both;
                animation-iteration-count: 2;
            }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    </script>
